text:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — proposing a lightweight 'field sprint' model for design partners: 2-week focused sprint, 3 partners per sprint, 1 narrow endpoint each (repro steps + eval prompt set). Goal: faster signal, lower partner load. Can we lock recruitment priority and launch criteria by Friday? cc @Ben @Carla @Mateo :calendar:
Ben (Eng): +1 on 2-week box. Curious about rollout: is this side-by-side with existing beta or replacing it?
Priya (PM): Side-by-side for now. Beta stays for long-running partners; field sprints = short, instrumented experiments to validate quick product bets.
Carla (GTM): Need clarity on partner profile. We should prioritize partners with production latency sensitivity and clear metric owners. Example: search-heavy apps, agents.
Mateo (Design): Agree. Also: prefer partners who can commit to weekly demos and a small in-house evaluator (1 PM/Eng).
Anya (Solutions): Incentives? $X credit vs. dedicated engineering time? Partners often want clear ROI (rollout playbook).
Priya (PM): Thinking: $2k credit + 4 hours onboarding support + prioritized roadmap slot if we ship. Open to alternatives.
Jordan (Infra): We need to pin SLA/rollback rules. If a sprint toggles new routing or quantization, define fallback. Ops has to provision canaries.
ops-bot: FYI: current Dedicated capacity for canaries available Mon/Wed next week — ping infra to reserve.
Priya (PM): Good call. Draft launch criteria (proposed):
```
- Partner signed MOU + NDA
- Intake score >= 7 (see rubric)
- Commitment to weekly demo + feedback form
- No PII in test data or explicit DPA in place
- Pre-approved rollback plan and monitoring alerts
```
Mateo (Design): Can you paste the intake rubric? Want to make sure product fit signal is high quality.
Priya (PM): Rubric (0-3 each):
```
- Product fit (0-3): How aligned is partner use-case with our roadmap?
- Commitment (0-3): Availability for 2-week sprint + demos
- Evaluation capability (0-3): Has someone to run prompt sets/metrics
- Infra readiness (0-3): Can they route test traffic / use staging keys
```
Ben (Eng): Suggest adding a "risk" axis (0-2) for infra impact (network, PII).
Priya (PM): Good. Update: intake total max = 14. Threshold 9+ to qualify.
Carla (GTM): Recruitment priority: 1) existing early adopters with production latency issues, 2) partners flagged by AE with clear KPIs, 3) new high-value logos.
Anya (Solutions): I can prepare a 90s outreach template and a short checklist for AEs.
Priya (PM): Awesome. Ops ask: how much support per sprint? We estimate 4 engineering hours + 2 infra hours + 3 hrs PM/Design. Is that realistic?
Jordan (Infra): 2 infra hours optimistic for first sprint. Reserve 4. Need canary configs + alerts.
Ben (Eng): Engineering time depends on scope: if it's model routing + policy toggles it's ~8h. If it's just prompt variant + eval harness maybe 3-4h.
Priya (PM): We'll gate scope per partner. Smallest scope = prompt+eval; medium = routing/variant; large = infra changes (rare).
Carla (GTM): How will we capture feedback? Standardized weekly survey + 30min interview + recorded demo. DevRel tracking?
DevRelBot: Auto-survey template created: https://forms.gle/field-sprint-feedback (will auto-collect responses into #dp-feedback-dashboard) :robot_face:
Anya (Solutions): Add a short NPS-style question and two free-text prompts: "friction" and "value seen".
Priya (PM): Launch checklist draft:
- Intake submitted + scored
- MOU signed
- Keys and staging access provisioned
- Monitoring + alerts configured
- Weekly survey scheduled in calendar
- Demo slot booked
Carla (GTM): What's our acceptance metric to say 'sprint succeeded'? We need one quantitative KPI + qualitative signoff.
Priya (PM): Proposed success metric: 1) signal: measurable improvement in partner KPI (latency or cost) OR 2) clear roadmap decision (ship/iterate/stop). Plus partner qualitative satisfaction >= 4/5.
Mateo (Design): Add "actionability" — did the sprint produce a clear next action for product/eng?
Ben (Eng): Also track technical regressions (error rate up, latency up). If any regression > 5% revert.
Priya (PM): Good. Can we finalize intake form, rubric thresholds, and outreach template by Thursday? I want to start outreach Friday for next-week sprint.
Carla (GTM): I'll draft outreach and pipeline tags today; will sync with Anya.
Jordan (Infra): I'll reserve canary windows and create an infra checklist doc.
Ben (Eng): I'll write a short "safe scope" list we can pick from for minimal engineering lift.
Mateo (Design): I'll prepare a 1-page eval rubric and sample prompt set.
Priya (PM): Thanks team. If no objections I'll lock criteria Friday 10am PT. Please drop any major blockers here before EOD. :eyes:
